name: Deck sharing
description: Share decks with friends: pick a folder you all share on OneDrive, Google Drive or Dropbox and your decks and theirs show up on one list, with a picture, who shared it and a note. Open a friend's deck and it's added to your decks (never over one of yours). Or send a deck as one file on Discord or by e-mail.
author: MEZTKING

page.title: Deck sharing
page.tooltip: Share decks with friends through a shared folder or a file
